# NexaTech Solutions — Company Profile
Document ID: KB-001
Document Type: Company Profile
Last Updated: 2026-02-15

NexaTech Solutions is a fictional enterprise technology company founded in 2019 and headquartered in Bengaluru, India. It develops software for enterprise search, workflow automation, and data governance.

Leadership:
- Rohan Mehta — Chief Executive Officer, since January 2021.
- Anika Rao — Chief Technology Officer, since July 2023.
- Meera Iyer — Chief Operating Officer, since April 2024.

Primary products:
- NovaSearch — enterprise knowledge search and question answering.
- FlowPilot — workflow automation platform.
- DataMesh Hub — data catalog and governance platform.

Markets: India and Singapore.

NovaSearch launched in March 2025. FlowPilot launched in September 2024. DataMesh Hub launched in November 2023.

NovaSearch Enterprise is listed at $49 per user per month with a 25-seat minimum. FlowPilot Business is listed at $79 per workspace per month and includes up to 20 active workflows. DataMesh Hub uses quote-based pricing.

NexaTech's hosted production services use TLS 1.3 for data in transit and AES-256 for data at rest. Standard hosted deployments use infrastructure in Singapore and have a 99.9% monthly availability target.

Customer support is available Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 IST for standard support. Premium Support provides 24/7 incident response.

Important scope: These facts are for the fictional benchmark and should not be treated as real-world company information.

Primary products:

- ForecastPro — demand forecasting platform.
- InsightFlow — operational analytics product.

Markets: India, UAE, and Singapore.

OrbitBI launched in April 2022. ForecastPro launched in August 2023. InsightFlow launched in January 2025.

OrbitBI Professional is priced at $29 per user per month with a 10-seat minimum. ForecastPro is priced at $99 per forecasting workspace per month. InsightFlow pricing is quote-based.

Standard customer support operates Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 IST. Priority customers receive extended incident support.

# Zenith Robotics — Company Profile
Document ID: KB-003
Document Type: Company Profile
Last Updated: 2026-02-15

Zenith Robotics is a fictional industrial automation company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Pune, India. It develops robotic inspection, warehouse automation, and fleet-management software.

Leadership:
- Sameer Kulkarni — Chief Executive Officer, since February 2020.
- Elena Thomas — Chief Technology Officer, since November 2022.
- Vikram Joshi — Chief Operating Officer, since May 2023.

Primary products:
- VisionInspect — AI-assisted visual inspection.
- RoboFleet — robotic fleet management.
- WarehousePilot — warehouse automation orchestration.

Markets: India, Germany, and Japan.

VisionInspect launched in February 2021. RoboFleet launched in October 2022. WarehousePilot launched in July 2024.

VisionInspect is priced at $149 per inspection station per month. RoboFleet is priced at $299 per robot per month. WarehousePilot uses annual enterprise contracts with quote-based pricing.

Hosted management services use TLS 1.3 for network encryption. Customer configuration data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. The standard hosted control plane is located in Frankfurt, Germany.

Standard support is Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 IST. Enterprise customers receive 24/7 critical-incident escalation.

Important scope: These facts are for the fictional benchmark and should not be treated as real-world company information.
